case.title: The 9/11 Commission Report
case.author: National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States
case.provenance: Owner-supplied PDF; local copy verified against byte count and SHA-256. GovInfo identifies the official government edition and links the PDF. No independent publisher re-fetch or byte-equivalence claim is made.
case.rightsBasis: Official U.S. Government commission report, retained as external development material. Source PDF is not bundled or relicensed under MIT; no blanket rights claim covers third-party illustrations.
coverage: numbered endnotes and inline note markers
case.reviewStatus: Full conversion measured; selected-page review in progress. The 46/54 false-heading count comes from Claude in another session, relayed by the owner; independent reproduction is deferred to issue #10.

ownerReportedFindings.finding: 46 of 54 detected headings in a sample were actually page headers.
ownerReportedFindings.status: Unverified cross-session finding; sample pages, extractor and methodology unspecified. Not a PDFReflowLib measurement.
ownerReportedFindings.provenance: Claude in another session, relayed by the owner; owner plans to request details.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS 27 arm64 isolated release CLI, defaults; initial ceiling with headroom over a measured 115.7 MiB exploratory peak, not a mobile-device budget

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction
